Public Module Leap
    Public Function IsLeapYear(ByVal year As Integer) As Boolean
        Return DivisibleBy(year, 4) AndAlso _
            (Not divisibleBy(year, 100) OrElse DivisibleBy(year, 400))
    End Function

    Private Function DivisibleBy(year As Integer, n As Integer) As Boolean
        Return year Mod n = 0
    End Function
End Module
